messages:
Tess: heads-up 1  PMs noticed weird per-model cards: variant A shows much lower 'token cost' than variant B even though routing sends most traffic to B. canopy?
Jun: saw that. looks like per-variant cache savings are being billed to the variant that warmed the cache, not the variant that hit it later.
Felix: other factor: quantized variants have lower runtime cost but higher token count (prompt expansion) in a few prompts, so unit economics are not comparable by raw token alone.
Priya: UX: teams want a single "per-model" card that breaks down by variant and shows effective cost per-1k tokens, plus cache-savings contribution and accuracy delta.
Tess: proposal: dashboard -> Per-Model view with stacked bars: base token spend, cache_credit (apportioned), quantization overhead (tokens changed), and effective cost normalized to 1k output tokens. add a small accuracy delta metric next to cost so PMs see tradeoffs.
Jun: data change: we currently only log model_id and model_sku. suggest we add optional fields model_variant_id and quant_profile to econ.events. Also add cache_origin_variant so we can attribute cache savings to the correct warmup variant.
Felix: cardinality: model_variant_id and quant_profile are bounded (we only have a few variants/profiles per model). shouldn't explode. however cache_origin_variant might increase lineages if we store full chains. keep it short string ids.
Priya: console feature: "what-if" slider for routing split (e.g., 80/20 A/B) that simulates costs using historical per-variant perf and cache-hit math. useful for rollout planning. UI will call econ/simulate?model=...&split=A:80,B:20 and display delta.
Tess: ops note: when routing falls back (latency or cost policy) we want to report both observed cost and 'attributable' cost. observed = what actually charged; attributable = pro-rated to origin variant when prefetching differs. helps chargeback.
Jun: implementation: small schema additions (optional strings): model_variant_id, quant_profile, cache_origin_variant. Add numeric field effective_tokens_out and effective_tokens_in to capture token inflation/deflation after quantized decoding differences.
Felix: sampling: we can capture full variant lineage for 5% deterministic sample per-tenant and full for paid customers. the aggregated dashboard can use sampled attribution to estimate apportionment for the rest.
Priya: UI asks: 1) per-model stacked bars 2) variant table with cost/1k, cache-credit%, accuracy-delta 3) What-if slider 4) tooltip "how cache is apportioned" linking to sampled traces. I'll mock these.
Tess: alerts: add an alert if model_variant cost/1k changes by >20% post-rollout for >30m. and alert if cache_credit attribution changes signficantly (>15% swing) after a deployment.
Jun: rollout plan: schema opt-in, sampling, backend sim endpoint, UI flag behind feature-flag. start with staging only and run canaries.
Felix: note: exclude canary traffic from aggregate amortized apportionment by default, but still show canary as a separate line in the per-model view.
Priya: action items:
- Jun: PR to emit model_variant_id, quant_profile, effective_tokens_in/out, cache_origin_variant (optional) in econ.events.
- Felix: sampling adapter + estimator for non-sampled attribution (5% default).
- Priya: UI mock + simulate endpoint contract.
- Tess: RFC + alerts config and rollout checklist.
deploy-bot: econ-service v2.20.1 deployed to staging (hash: g5h6i7j)
Jun: tests green for schema fields, opening PR now.
Felix: i'll prototype the estimator and post numbers for 5% sampling tonight.
Priya: mock will land in #design by EOD.
Tess: thanks team 1 meeting in 20 to walk the RFC and the mock. :thumbsup:
